title: [The Merry Kraken, Deck]
description: The Merry Kraken stretches wide and long, a kraken-carved arch leading into a covered area taking up the majority of the upper deck.  Flying from the mainmast is a white flag embroidered with a whimsical lemon yellow kraken holding several drinks in its lavender-hued tentacles.  Cargo waiting to be secured in the hold below is stacked neatly in multiple places across the deck, and a sign points to the arch saying, "Market of Lost Things this way."
